items.title: Jimmie "Kid" Clayton Interview
items.q: They had us playing Casey Jones and the Black Cat and everything.

ctx.x: I was riding them cowboys, you know how them cowboys, they rough. I said I don't want to eat orange no more. I don't eat orange no more. Don't hear nothing about orange touches. They had us playing Casey Jones and the Black Cat and everything. I played it. I was scared too, I'm telling you. I said when I get out there I'll lie, I ain't coming back.
You've got to believe it. That road's a tough thing, I wonder you don't go on that road.
